text: In 1922, a family living on an isolated German farm began noticing something terrifying...
Footprints appeared in the snow, leading from the nearby forest straight toward their farmhouse.
But there were no footprints leading back.
The family also reported hearing footsteps in the attic.
When they searched, nobody was there.
Then, on March 31st, something terrible happened.
Six people at the farm were killed.
Four days passed before their disappearance was discovered.
When neighbors finally entered the property, the entire household was gone.
But investigators noticed something deeply unsettling.
The farm appeared to have remained active after the murders.
The animals had been fed.
Smoke had reportedly been seen coming from the chimney.
Someone may have stayed there.
But who?
Police questioned more than 100 suspects over the following years.
Nobody was ever identified as the killer.
The farmhouse was eventually demolished.
And the mystery of Hinterkaifeck remains unsolved.
More than a century later... nobody knows who was inside that farmhouse.
